rows.note: Use this for the official Hong Kong police rank of inspector.

example.english: The inspector led the team to deal with a street fight.
example.traditional: 督察帶隊去處理街頭打鬥。
example.jyutping: duk1 caat3 daai2 deoi6 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 gaai1 tau4 daa2 dau3

rows.note: Use this colloquial or older term when referring to a police inspector rather than a general inspector.

example.english: The inspector used to patrol around here all the time.
example.traditional: 幫辦以前成日喺呢頭巡邏。
example.jyutping: bong1 baan2 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 hai2 ni1 tau4 ceon4 lo4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person employed to inspect something.

example.english: The inspector said the lift had to be taken out of service immediately.
example.traditional: 檢查員話部升降機要即刻停用。
example.jyutping: gim2 caa4 jyun4 waa6 bou6 sing1 gong3 gei1 jiu3 zik1 hak1 ting4 jung6
